fusions.name: Butting Circle
fusions.desc: A ring of cracks deals 14 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocks each back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Ram the Gap
fusions.desc: A short lash deals 5 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Plant the Hooves
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Hold the Ledge
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (42% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
